auth.signInToCreate: Sign in to create and manage your season.

home.title: Take turns hosting. Rate every dinner. Reveal the winner.
home.subtitle: A Prostřeno-style season: each friend hosts one dinner, guests score food, atmosphere and entertainment — and the scores stay sealed until the very end.

steps.createBody: Add your friends and pick who hosts when. Everyone gets a date.
steps.hostBody: On the day, the host shows a QR code. Guests scan, pick their name, and score the evening.
steps.revealBody: Scores stay hidden — even from the organizer — until every dinner is done. Then the leaderboard drops.

new.title: New season
new.playersHelp: Add everyone who will host and rate. At least two.
new.deadlineHelp: Results reveal automatically after this date even if some ratings are missing.

season.shareHint: Open a dinner on its day to show the QR code.
